0.0;\n    T c = 0.0;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        T y = val - c;\n        T t = sum + y;\n        c = (t - sum) - y;\n        sum = t;\n    }\n    return sum;\n}\n\n// Print results for floating-point arrays\ntemplate <typename T>\nvoid print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = \"Result\") {\n    if (data.empty()) {\n        printf(\"=== RESULTS ===\\n\");\n statistics\n    T sum = kahan_sum(data);\n    T min_val = data[0];\n    T max_val = data[0];\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);\n        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);\n    }\n    \n    // Compute hash\n    hash h;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        h.add(val);\n    }\n    \n    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1\n    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};\n    \n    printf(\"=== RESULTS ===\\n\");\n    printf(\"Name: %s\\n\", name);\n    printf(\"Elements: %zu\\n\", N);\n    printf(\"Sum: %.17e\\n\", {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011Cg79B9CSTdgC7eMJtHFSJ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01HKQDu39p3udEQkfQUqjhQu","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261011-092100/floydwarshall_claude-fable-5.1-cc-medium_mpi_r2/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Maximum number of pivot rows (intermediate nodes k) processed per block.\nconstexpr size_t MAX_BLOCK = 64;\n// Column tile width for the main update kernel (keeps the row tile in L1).\nconstexpr size_t COL_TILE = 256;\n// Marker for \"path entry untouched\" in the distributed pivot computation.\nconstexpr unsigned int PATH_UNSET = 0xFFFFFFFFu;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes,\n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Local part of the path matrix: the serial initialization sets every entry\n// of memory row r (all columns) to r, so each local row is filled with its\n// global row index.\nvoid initializeLocalPathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t rowBegin,\n                               const size_t rowsLocal, const size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < rowsLocal; ++li) {\n        std::fill_n(path.data() + li * numNodes, numNodes,\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>(rowBegin + li));\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed Floyd-Warshall\n//\n// Memory layout: dist[idx2(j, i, n)] == dist[i * n + j] is the distance from\n// source i to destination j, i.e. memory row i holds all destinations of\n// source i. The matrix is distributed by contiguous blocks of memory rows.\n//\n// The k loop is processed in blocks of B pivot rows. For block c, all ranks\n// need the \"pivot rows\" k in block c, each in the state it has after\n// iterations 0..k-1 (row k does not change during iteration k). These pivot\n// rows are computed cooperatively by all ranks (each rank handles a slice of\n// the columns, plus the small column tiles needed for dependencies), gathered\n// with an all-gather, and the final state of the block's rows is returned to\n// the owning rank. Every rank then applies the B pivots to its own rows in\n// the original k order, so distances and path entries are bit-identical to\n// the serial algorithm.\n//\n// Communication for block c+1 is overlapped with the update for block c.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Layout {\n    int P = 1;\n    int me = 0;\n    size_t n = 0;\n    size_t B = 1;          // pivot block size\n    size_t blocksPerRank = 1;\n    size_t nb = 0;         // number of blocks\n    size_t rowBegin = 0;   // local rows [rowBegin, rowEnd)\n    size_t rowEnd = 0;\n    std::vector<size_t> sliceOff;  // column slice per rank (size P+1)\n\n    size_t blockStart(size_t b) const { return b * B; }\n    size_t blockEnd(size_t b) const { return std::min(n, (b + 1) * B); }\n    size_t blockRows(size_t b) const { return blockEnd(b) - blockStart(b); }\n    int ownerOf(size_t b) const { return static_cast<int>(b / blocksPerRank); }\n    size_t sliceLen(int r) const { return sliceOff[r + 1] - sliceOff[r]; }\n    size_t rowsLocal() const { return rowEnd - rowBegin; }\n    int sliceOfColumn(size_t j) const {\n        // largest r with sliceOff[r] <= j and sliceLen(r) > 0\n        int r = static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(sliceOff.begin(), sliceOff.end(), j) -\n                                 sliceOff.begin()) - 1;\n        while (sliceLen(r) == 0) ++r;  // skip empty slices (sliceOff equal)\n        return r;\n    }\n    // Offset of pivot row kk of column slice r in the slice-major pivot buffer\n    size_t pivOff(int r, size_t kk, size_t Bb) const {\n        return sliceOff[r] * Bb + kk * sliceLen(r);\n    }\n};\n\nstatic Layout makeLayout(const size_t n, const int P, const int me) {\n    Layout L;\n    L.P = P;\n    L.me = me;\n    L.n = n;\n\n    // Rows per rank, split into blocksPerRank blocks of at most MAX_BLOCK rows\n    // each so that the row distribution stays balanced.\n    const size_t rpr = (n + P - 1) / P;\n    size_t target = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(MAX_BLOCK, rpr / 2));\n    L.blocksPerRank = std::max<size_t>(1, (rpr + target - 1) / target);\n    L.B = std::max<size_t>(1, (rpr + L.blocksPerRank - 1) / L.blocksPerRank);\n    L.nb = (n + L.B - 1) / L.B;\n\n    const size_t b0 = std::min(L.nb, L.blocksPerRank * static_cast<size_t>(me));\n    const size_t b1 = std::min(L.nb, L.blocksPerRank * static_cast<size_t>(me + 1));\n    L.rowBegin = std::min(n, b0 * L.B);\n    L.rowEnd = std::min(n, b1 * L.B);\n\n    L.sliceOff.resize(P + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= P; ++r) {\n        L.sliceOff[r] = (n * static_cast<size_t>(r)) / static_cast<size_t>(P);\n    }\n    return L;\n}\n\nstruct Seg {\n    int r;        // column slice containing [j0, j1)\n    size_t j0, j1;\n    bool path;    // track path updates (segment lies in my column slice)\n};\n\n// Columns [t0, t1) (dist only, split by slice) plus my own slice (with path).\nstatic std::vector<Seg> buildSegments(const Layout& L, size_t t0, size_t t1) {\n    std::vector<Seg> segs;\n    const size_t s0 = L.sliceOff[L.me];\n    const size_t s1 = L.sliceOff[L.me + 1];\n    auto addTile = [&](size_t a, size_t b) {\n        while (a < b) {\n            const int r = L.sliceOfColumn(a);\n            const size_t e = std::min(b, L.sliceOff[r + 1]);\n            segs.push_back({r, a, e, false});\n            a = e;\n        }\n    };\n    // tile minus slice\n    if (t0 < t1) {\n        if (t1 <= s0 || t0 >= s1) {\n            addTile(t0, t1);\n        } else {\n            if (t0 < s0) addTile(t0, s0);\n            if (t1 > s1) addTile(s1, t1);\n        }\n    }\n    if (s1 > s0) segs.push_back({L.me, s0, s1, true});\n    return segs;\n}\n\n// Apply the pivot update of row i with hoisted a = R_i[k] over a segment,\n// pivot values given by pk[j - j0].\nstatic inline void updateSegment(unsigned int* __restrict Ri, unsigned int* __restrict Pi,\n                                 const unsigned int* __restrict pk, const unsigned int a,\n                                 const unsigned int k, const size_t len) {\n    if (Pi) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < len; ++j) {\n            const unsigned int nd = a + pk[j];\n            const bool lt = nd < Ri[j];\n            Ri[j] = lt ? nd : Ri[j];\n            Pi[j] = lt ? k : Pi[j];\n        }\n    } else {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < len; ++j) {\n            const unsigned int nd = a + pk[j];\n            Ri[j] = nd < Ri[j] ? nd : Ri[j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Apply pivot block b (Bb rows, in slice-major buffer piv, global k offset\n// kb0) to one local row.\nstatic inline void updateRow(unsigned int* __restrict row, unsigned int* __restrict prow,\n                             const unsigned int* __restrict piv, const unsigned int* __restrict diag,\n                             const size_t Bb, const size_t kb0, const Layout& L) {\n    unsigned int a[MAX_BLOCK];\n\n    // First evolve the B columns of the pivot block itself (they are needed as\n    // the hoisted row[k] values and must have all earlier k applied).\n    for (size_t kk = 0; kk < Bb; ++kk) {\n        const unsigned int ak = row[kb0 + kk];\n        a[kk] = ak;\n        const unsigned int k = static_cast<unsigned int>(kb0 + kk);\n        const unsigned int* dk = diag + kk * Bb;\n        unsigned int* d = row + kb0;\n        unsigned int* p = prow + kb0;\n        for (size_t jj = 0; jj < Bb; ++jj) {\n            const unsigned int nd = ak + dk[jj];\n            const bool lt = nd < d[jj];\n            d[jj] = lt ? nd : d[jj];\n            p[jj] = lt ? k : p[jj];\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Then all columns, tiled so the row tile stays in L1 across the kk loop.\n    // Re-applying to the pivot-block columns is a no-op (already minimal).\n    for (int r = 0; r < L.P; ++r) {\n        const size_t len = L.sliceLen(r);\n        if (len == 0) continue;\n        const unsigned int* base = piv + L.pivOff(r, 0, Bb);\n        unsigned int* d = row + L.sliceOff[r];\n        unsigned int* p = prow + L.sliceOff[r];\n        for (size_t jt = 0; jt < len; jt += COL_TILE) {\n            const size_t tl = std::min(COL_TILE, len - jt);\n            unsigned int* __restrict dd = d + jt;\n            unsigned int* __restrict pp = p + jt;\n            for (size_t kk = 0; kk < Bb; ++kk) {\n                const unsigned int* __restrict pk = base + kk * len + jt;\n                const unsigned int ak = a[kk];\n                const unsigned int k = static_cast<unsigned int>(kb0 + kk);\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < tl; ++j) {\n                    const unsigned int nd = ak + pk[j];\n                    const bool lt = nd < dd[j];\n                    dd[j] = lt ? nd : dd[j];\n                    pp[j] = lt ? k : pp[j];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Cooperative pivot computation for block c on the rows R (state after block\n// c-2, Bc rows, plain row-major). If c > 0, first applies block c-1 (pivots in\n// pivPrev), then evolves through block c, recording the pivot snapshots of my\n// column slice into pivNext and the final dist/path of my slice into stage.\nstatic void computePivotBlock(const Layout& L, const size_t c, unsigned int* R,\n                              const unsigned int* pivPrev, unsigned int* pivNext,\n                              unsigned int* stage) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    const size_t Bc = L.blockRows(c);\n    const size_t kc0 = L.blockStart(c);\n    const size_t kc1 = L.blockEnd(c);\n    const size_t s0 = L.sliceOff[L.me];\n    const size_t sl = L.sliceLen(L.me);\n\n    unsigned int* stageDist = stage;\n    unsigned int* stagePath = stage + Bc * sl;\n    std::fill_n(stagePath, Bc * sl, PATH_UNSET);\n\n    if (c > 0) {\n        const size_t Bp = L.blockRows(c - 1);\n        const size_t kp0 = L.blockStart(c - 1);\n        const std::vector<Seg> segs = buildSegments(L, kp0, kc1);\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < Bp; ++kk) {\n            const unsigned int k = static_cast<unsigned int>(kp0 + kk);\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < Bc; ++i) {\n                unsigned int* Ri = R + i * n;\n                const unsigned int a = Ri[k];\n                for (const Seg& s : segs) {\n                    const unsigned int* pk =\n                        pivPrev + L.pivOff(s.r, kk, Bp) + (s.j0 - L.sliceOff[s.r]);\n                    updateSegment(Ri + s.j0, s.path ? stagePath + i * sl + (s.j0 - s0) : nullptr,\n                                  pk, a, k, s.j1 - s.j0);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    {\n        const std::vector<Seg> segs = buildSegments(L, kc0, kc1);\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < Bc; ++kk) {\n            const unsigned int k = static_cast<unsigned int>(kc0 + kk);\n            const unsigned int* Rk = R + kk * n;\n            // snapshot of pivot row k (state after iterations < k) for my slice\n            std::copy_n(Rk + s0, sl, pivNext + L.pivOff(L.me, kk, Bc));\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < Bc; ++i) {\n                if (i == kk) continue;  // row k is unchanged by pivot k\n                unsigned int* Ri = R + i * n;\n                const unsigned int a = Ri[k];\n                for (const Seg& s : segs) {\n                    updateSegment(Ri + s.j0, s.path ? stagePath + i * sl + (s.j0 - s0) : nullptr,\n                                  Rk + s.j0, a, k, s.j1 - s.j0);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < Bc; ++i) {\n        std::copy_n(R + i * n + s0, sl, stageDist + i * sl);\n    }\n}\n\n// Owner of block c: merge gathered final rows (slice-major per rank) into the\n// local dist/path rows.\nstatic void mergeFinalRows(const Layout& L, const size_t c, const unsigned int* gathered,\n                           std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, std::vector<unsigned int>& path) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    const size_t Bc = L.blockRows(c);\n    const size_t lrow0 = L.blockStart(c) - L.rowBegin;\n    for (int r = 0; r < L.P; ++r) {\n        const size_t sl = L.sliceLen(r);\n        if (sl == 0) continue;\n        const unsigned int* gd = gathered + 2 * Bc * L.sliceOff[r];\n        const unsigned int* gp = gd + Bc * sl;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < Bc; ++i) {\n            unsigned int* drow = dist.data() + (lrow0 + i) * n + L.sliceOff[r];\n            unsigned int* prow = path.data() + (lrow0 + i) * n + L.sliceOff[r];\n            const unsigned int* sd = gd + i * sl;\n            const unsigned int* sp = gp + i * sl;\n            std::copy_n(sd, sl, drow);\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < sl; ++j) {\n                if (sp[j] != PATH_UNSET) prow[j] = sp[j];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void extractDiagTile(const Layout& L, const size_t b, const unsigned int* piv,\n                            unsigned int* diag) {\n    const size_t Bb = L.blockRows(b);\n    const size_t kb0 = L.blockStart(b);\n    for (size_t jj = 0; jj < Bb; ++jj) {\n        const size_t j = kb0 + jj;\n        const int r = L.sliceOfColumn(j);\n        const size_t jo = j - L.sliceOff[r];\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < Bb; ++kk) {\n            diag[kk * Bb + jj] = piv[L.pivOff(r, kk, Bb) + jo];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstatic inline void progressRequests(MPI_Request* reqs, int count) {\n    int flag;\n    MPI_Testall(count, reqs, &flag, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                   const Layout& L) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    const size_t nb = L.nb;\n    if (nb == 0) return;\n    const int P = L.P;\n    const int me = L.me;\n    const size_t B = L.B;\n    const size_t mySl = L.sliceLen(me);\n\n    MPI_Datatype rowType;\n    MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(n), MPI_UNSIGNED, &rowType);\n    MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n\n    std::vector<unsigned int> Rbuf[2] = {std::vector<unsigned int>(B * n),\n                                         std::vector<unsigned int>(B * n)};\n    std::vector<unsigned int> piv[2] = {std::vector<unsigned int>(B * n),\n                                        std::vector<unsigned int>(B * n)};\n    std::vector<unsigned int> stage(2 * B * mySl);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> gathered;\n    std::vector<unsigned int> diag(B * B);\n    std::vector<int> gCounts(P), gDispls(P), fCounts(P), fDispls(P);\n\n    MPI_Request reqR[2] = {MPI_REQUEST_NULL, MPI_REQUEST_NULL};  // R(m) in Rbuf[m&1]\n    MPI_Request reqG = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;  // all-gather of pivot snapshots\n    MPI_Request reqF = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;  // gather of final rows to owner\n\n    auto postRecvR = [&](size_t m) {\n        MPI_Ibcast(Rbuf[m & 1].data(), static_cast<int>(L.blockRows(m)), rowType,\n                   L.ownerOf(m), MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqR[m & 1]);\n    };\n    auto sendR = [&](size_t m) {\n        // owner: copy current state of block m rows into the buffer and post\n        const size_t Bm = L.blockRows(m);\n        std::copy_n(dist.data() + (L.blockStart(m) - L.rowBegin) * n, Bm * n, Rbuf[m & 1].data());\n        MPI_Ibcast(Rbuf[m & 1].data(), static_cast<int>(Bm), rowType, me, MPI_COMM_WORLD,\n                   &reqR[m & 1]);\n    };\n    auto postPivotCollectives = [&](size_t c, unsigned int* pivNext) {\n        const size_t Bc = L.blockRows(c);\n        for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n            gCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(Bc * L.sliceLen(r));\n            gDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(Bc * L.sliceOff[r]);\n            fCounts[r] = 2 * gCounts[r];\n            fDispls[r] = 2 * gDispls[r];\n        }\n        MPI_Iallgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, pivNext, gCounts.data(),\n                        gDispls.data(), MPI_UNSIGNED, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqG);\n        const int owner = L.ownerOf(c);\n        if (owner == me) gathered.resize(2 * Bc * n);\n        MPI_Igatherv(stage.data(), static_cast<int>(2 * Bc * mySl), MPI_UNSIGNED,\n                     owner == me ? gathered.data() : nullptr, fCounts.data(), fDispls.data(),\n                     MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqF);\n    };\n\n    int cur = 0;\n\n    // Prologue: distribute initial rows of blocks 0 and 1, compute pivot block 0.\n    if (L.ownerOf(0) == me) sendR(0); else postRecvR(0);\n    if (nb > 1) { if (L.ownerOf(1) == me) sendR(1); else postRecvR(1); }\n    MPI_Wait(&reqR[0], MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n    computePivotBlock(L, 0, Rbuf[0].data(), nullptr, piv[cur].data(), stage.data());\n    postPivotCollectives(0, piv[cur].data());\n    MPI_Wait(&reqG, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n    MPI_Wait(&reqF, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n    if (L.ownerOf(0) == me) mergeFinalRows(L, 0, gathered.data(), dist, path);\n\n    for (size_t b = 0; b < nb; ++b) {\n        const size_t Bb = L.blockRows(b);\n        const size_t kb0 = L.blockStart(b);\n        const int next = cur ^ 1;\n\n        // Start the pivot computation for block b+1 (overlapped with main update).\n        if (b + 1 < nb) {\n            MPI_Wait(&reqR[(b + 1) & 1], MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            computePivotBlock(L, b + 1, Rbuf[(b + 1) & 1].data(), piv[cur].data(),\n                              piv[next].data(), stage.data());\n            postPivotCollectives(b + 1, piv[next].data());\n        }\n        const bool ownNext2 = (b + 2 < nb) && L.ownerOf(b + 2) == me;\n        if (b + 2 < nb && !ownNext2) postRecvR(b + 2);\n\n        extractDiagTile(L, b, piv[cur].data(), diag.data());\n\n        // Main update of local rows with pivot block b. Rows of block b and\n        // b+1 owned by me are produced by the cooperative pivot computation\n        // and are skipped here.\n        auto rowSkipped = [&](size_t gi) {\n            const size_t blk = gi / B;\n            return blk == b || blk == b + 1;\n        };\n        auto doRows = [&](size_t g0, size_t g1) {\n            MPI_Request reqs[4] = {reqR[0], reqR[1], reqG, reqF};\n            size_t sinceTest = 0;\n            for (size_t gi = g0; gi < g1; ++gi) {\n                if (rowSkipped(gi)) continue;\n                const size_t li = gi - L.rowBegin;\n                updateRow(dist.data() + li * n, path.data() + li * n, piv[cur].data(),\n                          diag.data(), Bb, kb0, L);\n                if (++sinceTest >= 8) {\n                    sinceTest = 0;\n                    reqs[0] = reqR[0]; reqs[1] = reqR[1]; reqs[2] = reqG; reqs[3] = reqF;\n                    progressRequests(reqs, 4);\n                    reqR[0] = reqs[0]; reqR[1] = reqs[1]; reqG = reqs[2]; reqF = reqs[3];\n                }\n            }\n        };\n        if (ownNext2) {\n            // Rows of block b+2 first, so their state after block b can be\n            // broadcast while the remaining rows are being updated.\n            const size_t r0 = L.blockStart(b + 2);\n            const size_t r1 = L.blockEnd(b + 2);\n            doRows(r0, r1);\n            sendR(b + 2);\n            doRows(L.rowBegin, r0);\n            doRows(r1, L.rowEnd);\n        } else {\n            doRows(L.rowBegin, L.rowEnd);\n        }\n\n        if (b + 1 < nb) {\n            MPI_Wait(&reqG, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            MPI_Wait(&reqF, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            if (L.ownerOf(b + 1) == me) mergeFinalRows(L, b + 1, gathered.data(), dist, path);\n            cur = next;\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n\n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\",\n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int P = 1, me = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &P);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &me);\n    const bool root = (me == 0);\n\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", P);\n    }\n\n    const Layout L = makeLayout(numNodes, P, me);\n    const size_t rowsLocal = L.rowsLocal();\n\n    MPI_Datatype rowType = MPI_DATATYPE_NULL;\n    std::vector<int> rowCounts(P), rowDispls(P);\n    if (numNodes > 0) {\n        MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(numNodes), MPI_UNSIGNED, &rowType);\n        MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n        for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n            const Layout Lr = makeLayout(numNodes, P, r);\n            rowCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(Lr.rowsLocal());\n            rowDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(Lr.rowBegin);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Allocate matrices: full distance matrix on rank 0 (for initialization and\n    // result collection), distributed row blocks everywhere.\n    std::vector<unsigned int> dist;\n    if (root) dist.resize(numNodes * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> distLocal(rowsLocal * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> pathLocal(rowsLocal * numNodes);\n\n    // Initialize\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");\n        initializeDistanceMatrix(dist, numNodes, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);\n    }\n    initializeLocalPathMatrix(pathLocal, L.rowBegin, rowsLocal, numNodes);\n    if (numNodes > 0) {\n        MPI_Scatterv(root ? dist.data() : nullptr, rowCounts.data(), rowDispls.data(), rowType,\n                     distLocal.data(), static_cast<int>(rowsLocal), rowType, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    }\n\n    // Run Floyd-Warshall\n    if (root) printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    floydWarshall(distLocal, pathLocal, L);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n\n    // Collect the full distance matrix on rank 0\n    if (numNodes > 0) {\n        MPI_Gatherv(distLocal.data(), static_cast<int>(rowsLocal), rowType,\n                    root ? dist.data() : nullptr, rowCounts.data(), rowDispls.data(), rowType,\n                    0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Local part of the path matrix: the serial initialization sets every entry\n// of memory row r (all columns) to r, so each local row is filled with its\n// global row index.\nvoid initializeLocalPathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t rowBegin,\n                               const size_t rowsLocal, const size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < rowsLocal; ++li) {\n        std::fill_n(path.data() + li * numNodes, numNodes,\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>(rowBegin + li));\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed Floyd-Warshall\n//\n// Memory layout: dist[idx2(j, i, n)] == dist[i * n + j] is the distance from\n// source i to destination j, i.e. memory row i holds all destinations of\n// source i. The matrix is distributed by contiguous blocks of memory rows.\n//\n// The k loop is processed in blocks of B pivot rows. For block c, all ranks\n// need the \"pivot rows\" k in block c, each in the state it has after\n// iterations 0..k-1 (row k does not change during iteration k). These pivot\n// rows are computed cooperatively by all ranks (each rank handles a slice of\n// the columns, plus the small column tiles needed for dependencies), gathered\n// with an all-gather, and the final state of the block's rows is returned to\n// the owning rank. Every rank then applies the B pivots to its own rows in\n// the original k order, so distances and path entries are bit-identical to\n// the serial algorithm.\n//\n// Communication for block c+1 is overlapped with the update for block c.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Layout {\n    int P = 1;\n    int me = 0;\n    size_t n = 0;\n    size_t B = 1;          // pivot block size\n    size_t blocksPerRank = 1;\n    size_t nb = 0;         // number of blocks\n    size_t rowBegin = 0;   // local rows [rowBegin, rowEnd)\n    size_t rowEnd = 0;\n    std::vector<size_t> sliceOff;  // column slice per rank (size P+1)\n\n    size_t blockStart(size_t b) const { return b * B; }\n    size_t blockEnd(size_t b) const { return std::min(n, (b + 1) * B); }\n    size_t blockRows(size_t b) const { return blockEnd(b) - blockStart(b); }\n    int ownerOf(size_t b) const { return static_cast<int>(b / blocksPerRank); }\n    size_t sliceLen(int r) const { return sliceOff[r + 1] - sliceOff[r]; }\n    size_t rowsLocal() const { return rowEnd - rowBegin; }\n    int sliceOfColumn(size_t j) const {\n        // largest r with sliceOff[r] <= j and sliceLen(r) > 0\n        int r = static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(sliceOff.begin(), sliceOff.end(), j) -\n                                 sliceOff.begin()) - 1;\n        while (sliceLen(r) == 0) ++r;  // skip empty slices (sliceOff equal)\n        return r;\n    }\n    // Offset of pivot row kk of column slice r in the slice-major pivot buffer\n    size_t pivOff(int r, size_t kk, size_t Bb) const {\n        return sliceOff[r] * Bb + kk * sliceLen(r);\n    }\n};\n\nstatic Layout makeLayout(const size_t n, const int P, const int me) {\n    Layout L;\n    L.P = P;\n    L.me = me;\n    L.n = n;\n\n    // Rows per rank, split into blocksPerRank blocks of at most MAX_BLOCK rows\n    // each so that the row distribution stays balanced.\n    const size_t rpr = (n + P - 1) / P;\n    size_t target = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(MAX_BLOCK, rpr / 2));\n    L.blocksPerRank = std::max<size_t>(1, (rpr + target - 1) / target);\n    L.B = std::max<size_t>(1, (rpr + L.blocksPerRank - 1) / L.blocksPerRank);\n    L.nb = (n + L.B - 1) / L.B;\n\n    const size_t b0 = std::min(L.nb, L.blocksPerRank * static_cast<size_t>(me));\n    const size_t b1 = std::min(L.nb, L.blocksPerRank * static_cast<size_t>(me + 1));\n    L.rowBegin = std::min(n, b0 * L.B);\n    L.rowEnd = std::min(n, b1 * L.B);\n\n    L.sliceOff.resize(P + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= P; ++r) {\n        L.sliceOff[r] = (n * static_cast<size_t>(r)) / static_cast<size_t>(P);\n    }\n    return L;\n}\n\nstruct Seg {\n    int r;        // column slice containing [j0, j1)\n    size_t j0, j1;\n    bool path;    // track path updates (segment lies in my column slice)\n};\n\n// Columns [t0, t1) (dist only, split by slice) plus my own slice (with path).\nstatic std::vector<Seg> buildSegments(const Layout& L, size_t t0, size_t t1) {\n    std::vector<Seg> segs;\n    const size_t s0 = L.sliceOff[L.me];\n    const size_t s1 = L.sliceOff[L.me + 1];\n    auto addTile = [&](size_t a, size_t b) {\n        while (a < b) {\n            const int r = L.sliceOfColumn(a);\n            const size_t e = std::min(b, L.sliceOff[r + 1]);\n            segs.push_back({r, a, e, false});\n            a = e;\n        }\n    };\n    // tile minus slice\n    if (t0 < t1) {\n        if (t1 <= s0 || t0 >= s1) {\n            addTile(t0, t1);\n        } else {\n            if (t0 < s0) addTile(t0, s0);\n            if (t1 > s1) addTile(s1, t1);\n        }\n    }\n    if (s1 > s0) segs.push_back({L.me, s0, s1, true});\n    return segs;\n}\n\n// Apply the pivot update of row i with hoisted a = R_i[k] over a segment,\n// pivot values given by pk[j - j0].\nstatic inline void updateSegment(unsigned int* __restrict Ri, unsigned int* __restrict Pi,\n                                 const unsigned int* __restrict pk, const unsigned int a,\n                                 const unsigned int k, const size_t len) {\n    if (Pi) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < len; ++j) {\n            const unsigned int nd = a + pk[j];\n            const bool lt = nd < Ri[j];\n            Ri[j] = lt ? nd : Ri[j];\n            Pi[j] = lt ? k : Pi[j];\n        }\n    } else {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < len; ++j) {\n            const unsigned int nd = a + pk[j];\n            Ri[j] = nd < Ri[j] ? nd : Ri[j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Apply pivot block b (Bb rows, in slice-major buffer piv, global k offset\n// kb0) to one local row.\nstatic inline void updateRow(unsigned int* __restrict row, unsigned int* __restrict prow,\n                             const unsigned int* __restrict piv, const unsigned int* __restrict diag,\n                             const size_t Bb, const size_t kb0, const Layout& L) {\n    unsigned int a[MAX_BLOCK];\n\n    // First evolve the B columns of the pivot block itself (they are needed as\n    // the hoisted row[k] values and must have all earlier k applied).\n    for (size_t kk = 0; kk < Bb; ++kk) {\n        const unsigned int ak = row[kb0 + kk];\n        a[kk] = ak;\n        const unsigned int k = static_cast<unsigned int>(kb0 + kk);\n        const unsigned int* dk = diag + kk * Bb;\n        unsigned int* d = row + kb0;\n        unsigned int* p = prow + kb0;\n        for (size_t jj = 0; jj < Bb; ++jj) {\n            const unsigned int nd = ak + dk[jj];\n            const bool lt = nd < d[jj];\n            d[jj] = lt ? nd : d[jj];\n            p[jj] = lt ? k : p[jj];\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Then all columns, tiled so the row tile stays in L1 across the kk loop.\n    // Re-applying to the pivot-block columns is a no-op (already minimal).\n    for (int r = 0; r < L.P; ++r) {\n        const size_t len = L.sliceLen(r);\n        if (len == 0) continue;\n        const unsigned int* base = piv + L.pivOff(r, 0, Bb);\n        unsigned int* d = row + L.sliceOff[r];\n        unsigned int* p = prow + L.sliceOff[r];\n        for (size_t jt = 0; jt < len; jt += COL_TILE) {\n            const size_t tl = std::min(COL_TILE, len - jt);\n            unsigned int* __restrict dd = d + jt;\n            unsigned int* __restrict pp = p + jt;\n            for (size_t kk = 0; kk < Bb; ++kk) {\n                const unsigned int* __restrict pk = base + kk * len + jt;\n                const unsigned int ak = a[kk];\n                const unsigned int k = static_cast<unsigned int>(kb0 + kk);\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < tl; ++j) {\n                    const unsigned int nd = ak + pk[j];\n                    const bool lt = nd < dd[j];\n                    dd[j] = lt ? nd : dd[j];\n                    pp[j] = lt ? k : pp[j];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Cooperative pivot computation for block c on the rows R (state after block\n// c-2, Bc rows, plain row-major). If c > 0, first applies block c-1 (pivots in\n// pivPrev), then evolves through block c, recording the pivot snapshots of my\n// column slice into pivNext and the final dist/path of my slice into stage.\nstatic void computePivotBlock(const Layout& L, const size_t c, unsigned int* R,\n                              const unsigned int* pivPrev, unsigned int* pivNext,\n                              unsigned int* stage) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    const size_t Bc = L.blockRows(c);\n    const size_t kc0 = L.blockStart(c);\n    const size_t kc1 = L.blockEnd(c);\n    const size_t s0 = L.sliceOff[L.me];\n    const size_t sl = L.sliceLen(L.me);\n\n    unsigned int* stageDist = stage;\n    unsigned int* stagePath = stage + Bc * sl;\n    std::fill_n(stagePath, Bc * sl, PATH_UNSET);\n\n    if (c > 0) {\n        const size_t Bp = L.blockRows(c - 1);\n        const size_t kp0 = L.blockStart(c - 1);\n        const std::vector<Seg> segs = buildSegments(L, kp0, kc1);\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < Bp; ++kk) {\n            const unsigned int k = static_cast<unsigned int>(kp0 + kk);\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < Bc; ++i) {\n                unsigned int* Ri = R + i * n;\n                const unsigned int a = Ri[k];\n                for (const Seg& s : segs) {\n                    const unsigned int* pk =\n                        pivPrev + L.pivOff(s.r, kk, Bp) + (s.j0 - L.sliceOff[s.r]);\n                    updateSegment(Ri + s.j0, s.path ? stagePath + i * sl + (s.j0 - s0) : nullptr,\n                                  pk, a, k, s.j1 - s.j0);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    {\n        const std::vector<Seg> segs = buildSegments(L, kc0, kc1);\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < Bc; ++kk) {\n            const unsigned int k = static_cast<unsigned int>(kc0 + kk);\n            const unsigned int* Rk = R + kk * n;\n            // snapshot of pivot row k (state after iterations < k) for my slice\n            std::copy_n(Rk + s0, sl, pivNext + L.pivOff(L.me, kk, Bc));\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < Bc; ++i) {\n                if (i == kk) continue;  // row k is unchanged by pivot k\n                unsigned int* Ri = R + i * n;\n                const unsigned int a = Ri[k];\n                for (const Seg& s : segs) {\n                    updateSegment(Ri + s.j0, s.path ? stagePath + i * sl + (s.j0 - s0) : nullptr,\n                                  Rk + s.j0, a, k, s.j1 - s.j0);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < Bc; ++i) {\n        std::copy_n(R + i * n + s0, sl, stageDist + i * sl);\n    }\n}\n\n// Owner of block c: merge gathered final rows (slice-major per rank) into the\n// local dist/path rows.\nstatic void mergeFinalRows(const Layout& L, const size_t c, const unsigned int* gathered,\n                           std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, std::vector<unsigned int>& path) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    const size_t Bc = L.blockRows(c);\n    const size_t lrow0 = L.blockStart(c) - L.rowBegin;\n    for (int r = 0; r < L.P; ++r) {\n        const size_t sl = L.sliceLen(r);\n        if (sl == 0) continue;\n        const unsigned int* gd = gathered + 2 * Bc * L.sliceOff[r];\n        const unsigned int* gp = gd + Bc * sl;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < Bc; ++i) {\n            unsigned int* drow = dist.data() + (lrow0 + i) * n + L.sliceOff[r];\n            unsigned int* prow = path.data() + (lrow0 + i) * n + L.sliceOff[r];\n            const unsigned int* sd = gd + i * sl;\n            const unsigned int* sp = gp + i * sl;\n            std::copy_n(sd, sl, drow);\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < sl; ++j) {\n                if (sp[j] != PATH_UNSET) prow[j] = sp[j];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void extractDiagTile(const Layout& L, const size_t b, const unsigned int* piv,\n                            unsigned int* diag) {\n    const size_t Bb = L.blockRows(b);\n    const size_t kb0 = L.blockStart(b);\n    for (size_t jj = 0; jj < Bb; ++jj) {\n        const size_t j = kb0 + jj;\n        const int r = L.sliceOfColumn(j);\n        const size_t jo = j - L.sliceOff[r];\n        for (size_t kk = 0; kk < Bb; ++kk) {\n            diag[kk * Bb + jj] = piv[L.pivOff(r, kk, Bb) + jo];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstatic inline void progressRequests(MPI_Request* reqs, int count) {\n    int flag;\n    MPI_Testall(count, reqs, &flag, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                   const Layout& L) {\n    const size_t n = L.n;\n    const size_t nb = L.nb;\n    if (nb == 0) return;\n    const int P = L.P;\n    const int me = L.me;\n    const size_t B = L.B;\n    const size_t mySl = L.sliceLen(me);\n\n    MPI_Datatype rowType;\n    MPI_Type_contiguous(static_cast<int>(n), MPI_UNSIGNED, &rowType);\n    MPI_Type_commit(&rowType);\n\n    std::vector<unsigned int> Rbuf[2] = {std::vector<unsigned int>(B * n),\n                                         std::vector<unsigned int>(B * n)};\n    std::vector<unsigned int> piv[2] = {std::vector<unsigned int>(B * n),\n                                        std::vector<unsigned int>(B * n)};\n    std::vector<unsigned int> stage(2 * B * mySl);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> gathered;\n    std::vector<unsigned int> diag(B * B);\n    std::vector<int> gCounts(P), gDispls(P), fCounts(P), fDispls(P);\n\n    MPI_Request reqR[2] = {MPI_REQUEST_NULL, MPI_REQUEST_NULL};  // R(m) in Rbuf[m&1]\n    MPI_Request reqG = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;  // all-gather of pivot snapshots\n    MPI_Request reqF = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;  // gather of final rows to owner\n\n    auto postRecvR = [&](size_t m) {\n        MPI_Ibcast(Rbuf[m & 1].data(), static_cast<int>(L.blockRows(m)), rowType,\n                   L.ownerOf(m), MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqR[m & 1]);\n    };\n    auto sendR = [&](size_t m) {\n        // owner: copy current state of block m rows into the buffer and post\n        const size_t Bm = L.blockRows(m);\n        std::copy_n(dist.data() + (L.blockStart(m) - L.rowBegin) * n, Bm * n, Rbuf[m & 1].data());\n        MPI_Ibcast(Rbuf[m & 1].data(), static_cast<int>(Bm), rowType, me, MPI_COMM_WORLD,\n                   &reqR[m & 1]);\n    };\n    auto postPivotCollectives = [&](size_t c, unsigned int* pivNext) {\n        const size_t Bc = L.blockRows(c);\n        for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n            gCounts[r] = static_cast<int>(Bc * L.sliceLen(r));\n            gDispls[r] = static_cast<int>(Bc * L.sliceOff[r]);\n            fCounts[r] = 2 * gCounts[r];\n            fDispls[r] = 2 * gDispls[r];\n        }\n        MPI_Iallgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, pivNext, gCounts.data(),\n                        gDispls.data(), MPI_UNSIGNED, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqG);\n        const int owner = L.ownerOf(c);\n        if (owner == me) gathered.resize(2 * Bc * n);\n        MPI_Igatherv(stage.data(), static_cast<int>(2 * Bc * mySl), MPI_UNSIGNED,\n                     owner == me ? gathered.data() : nullptr, fCounts.data(), fDispls.data(),\n                     MPI_UNSIGNED, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &reqF);\n    };\n\n    int cur = 0;\n\n    // Prologue: distribute initial rows of blocks 0 and 1, compute pivot block 0.\n    if (L.ownerOf(0) == me) sendR(0); else postRecvR(0);\n    if (nb > 1) { if (L.ownerOf(1) == me) sendR(1); else postRecvR(1); }\n    MPI_Wait(&reqR[0], MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n    computePivotBlock(L, 0, Rbuf[0].data(), nullptr, piv[cur].data(), stage.data());\n    postPivotCollectives(0, piv[cur].data());\n    MPI_Wait(&reqG, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n    MPI_Wait(&reqF, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n    if (L.ownerOf(0) == me) mergeFinalRows(L, 0, gathered.data(), dist, path);\n\n    for (size_t b = 0; b < nb; ++b) {\n        const size_t Bb = L.blockRows(b);\n        const size_t kb0 = L.blockStart(b);\n        const int next = cur ^ 1;\n\n        // Start the pivot computation for block b+1 (overlapped with main update).\n        if (b + 1 < nb) {\n            MPI_Wait(&reqR[(b + 1) & 1], MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            computePivotBlock(L, b + 1, Rbuf[(b + 1) & 1].data(), piv[cur].data(),\n                              piv[next].data(), stage.data());\n            postPivotCollectives(b + 1, piv[next].data());\n        }\n        const bool ownNext2 = (b + 2 < nb) && L.ownerOf(b + 2) == me;\n        if (b + 2 < nb && !ownNext2) postRecvR(b + 2);\n\n        extractDiagTile(L, b, piv[cur].data(), diag.data());\n\n        // Main update of local rows with pivot block b. Rows of block b and\n        // b+1 owned by me are produced by the cooperative pivot computation\n        // and are skipped here.\n        auto rowSkipped = [&](size_t gi) {\n            const size_t blk = gi / B;\n            return blk == b || blk == b + 1;\n        };\n        auto doRows = [&](size_t g0, size_t g1) {\n            MPI_Request reqs[4] = {reqR[0], reqR[1], reqG, reqF};\n            size_t sinceTest = 0;\n            for (size_t gi = g0; gi < g1; ++gi) {\n                if (rowSkipped(gi)) continue;\n                const size_t li = gi - L.rowBegin;\n                updateRow(dist.data() + li * n, path.data() + li * n, piv[cur].data(),\n                          diag.data(), Bb, kb0, L);\n                if (++sinceTest >= 8) {\n                    sinceTest = 0;\n                    reqs[0] = reqR[0]; reqs[1] = reqR[1]; reqs[2] = reqG; reqs[3] = reqF;\n                    progressRequests(reqs, 4);\n                    reqR[0] = reqs[0]; reqR[1] = reqs[1]; reqG = reqs[2]; reqF = reqs[3];\n                }\n            }\n        };\n        if (ownNext2) {\n            // Rows of block b+2 first, so their state after block b can be\n            // broadcast while the remaining rows are being updated.\n            const size_t r0 = L.blockStart(b + 2);\n            const size_t r1 = L.blockEnd(b + 2);\n            doRows(r0, r1);\n            sendR(b + 2);\n            doRows(L.rowBegin, r0);\n            doRows(r1, L.rowEnd);\n        } else {\n            doRows(L.rowBegin, L.rowEnd);\n        }\n\n        if (b + 1 < nb) {\n            MPI_Wait(&reqG, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            MPI_Wait(&reqF, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n            if (L.ownerOf(b + 1) == me) mergeFinalRows(L, b + 1, gathered.data(), dist, path);\n            cur = next;\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Type_free(&rowType);\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, \n for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n    \n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node  path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, \n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, \n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n    // For each intermediate node k\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // For each source node i\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            // For each destination node j\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;\n                \n                if (newDist < distIJ) {\n                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;\n                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\", \n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n paths...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    floydWarshall(dist, path, numNodes);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity\n    double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f }\n    bool isDiag(size_t c) const { return inRow(c) && inCol(c); }\n    // local offsets of block c (only valid if inRow(c) / inCol(c))\n    size_t localRowOfBlock(size_t c) const { return rowBlkStart[c / static_cast<size_t>(Pr)]; {"]}],"originalFile":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Maximum number of pivot rows (intermediate nodes k) processed per block.\nconstexpr size_t MAX_BLOCK = 64;\n// Column tile width for the main update kernel (keeps the row tile in L1).\nconstexpr size_t COL_TILE = 256;\n// Marker for \"path entry untouched\" in the distributed pivot computation.\nconstexpr unsigned int PATH_UNSET = 0xFFFFFFFFu;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes,\n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n\n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Local part of the path matrix: the serial initialization sets every entry\n// of memory row r (all columns) to r, so each local row is filled with its\n// global row index.\nvoid initializeLocalPathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t rowBegin,\n                               const size_t rowsLocal, const size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < rowsLocal; ++li) {\n        std::fill_n(path.data() + li * numNodes, numNodes,\n                    static_cast<unsigned int>(rowBegin + li));\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed Floyd-Warshall\n//\n// Memory layout: dist[idx2(j, i, n)] == dist[i * n + j] is the distance from\n// source i to destination j, i.e. memory row i holds all destinations of\n// source i. The matrix is distributed by contiguous blocks of memory rows.\n//\n// The k loop is processed in blocks of B pivot rows. For block c, all ranks\n// need the \"pivot rows\" k in block c, each in the state it has after\n// iterations 0..k-1 (row k does not change during iteration k). These pivot\n// rows are computed cooperatively by all ranks (each rank handles a slice of\n// the columns, plus the small column tiles needed for dependencies), gathered\n// with an all-gather, and the final state of the block's rows is returned to\n// the owning rank. Every rank then applies the B pivots to its own rows in\n// the original k order, so distances and path entries are bit-identical to\n// the serial algorithm.\n//\n// Communication for block c+1 is overlapped with the update for block c.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Layout {\n    int P = 1;\n    int me = 0;\n    size_t n = 0;\n    size_t B = 1;          // pivot block size\n    size_t blocksPerRank = 1;\n    size_t nb = 0;         // number of blocks\n    size_t rowBegin = 0;   // local rows [rowBegin, rowEnd)\n    size_t rowEnd = 0;\n    std::vector<size_t> sliceOff;  // column slice per rank (size P+1)\n\n    size_t blockStart(size_t b) const { return b * B; }\n    size_t blockEnd(size_t b) const { return std::min(n, (b + 1) * B); }\n    size_t blockRows(size_t b) const { return blockEnd(b) - blockStart(b); }\n    int ownerOf(size_t b) const { return static_cast<int>(b / blocksPerRank); }\n    size_t sliceLen(int r) const { return sliceOff[r + 1] - sliceOff[r]; }\n    size_t rowsLocal() const { return rowEnd - rowBegin; }\n    int sliceOfColumn(size_t j) const {\n        // largest r with sliceOff[r] <= j and sliceLen(r) > 0\n        int r = static_cast<int>(std::upper_bound(sliceOff.begin(), sliceOff.end(), j) -\n                                 sliceOff.begin()) - 1;\n        while (sliceLen(r) == 0) ++r;  // skip empty slices (sliceOff equal)\n        return r;\n    }\n    // Offset of pivot row kk of column slice r in the slice-major pivot buffer\n    size_t pivOff(int r, size_t kk, size_t Bb) const {\n        return sliceOff[r] * Bb + kk * sliceLen(r);\n    }\n};\n\nstatic Layout makeLayout(const size_t n, const int P, const int me) {\n    Layout L;\n    L.P = P;\n    L.me = me;\n    L.n = n;\n\n    // Rows per rank, split into blocksPerRank blocks of at most MAX_BLOCK rows\n    // each so that the row distribution stays balanced.\n    const size_t rpr = (n + P - 1) / P;\n    size_t target = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min<size_t>(MAX_BLOCK, rpr / 2));\n    L.blocksPerRank = std::max<size_t>(1, (rpr + target - 1) / target);\n    L.B = std::max<size_t>(1, (rpr + L.blocksPerRank - 1) / L.blocksPerRank);\n    L.nb = (n + L.B - 1) / L.B;\n\n    const size_t b0 = std::min(L.nb, L.blocksPerRank * static_cast<size_t>(me));\n    const size_t b1 = std::min(L.nb, L.blocksPerRank * static_cast<size_t>(me + 1));\n    L.rowBegin = std::min(n, b0 * L.B);\n    L.rowEnd = std::min(n, b1 * L.B);\n\n    L.sliceOff.resize(P + 1);\n    for (int r = 0; r <= P; ++r) {\n        L.sliceOff[r] = (n * static_cast<size_t>(r)) / static_cast<size_t>(P);\n    }\n    return L;\n}\n\nstruct Seg {\n    int r;        // column slice containing [j0, j1)\n    size_t j0, j1;\n    bool path; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011Cg7DUQtCbWt8ctPb6U76X","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"That file is the harness's own session log, not something the program or I created, so I left it alone.\n\n## Summary\n\nThe Floyd-Warshall benchmark in `floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp` is now a pure-MPI distributed implementation. Only the two existing files were modified, the executable is still named `floydwarshall`, and no new dependencies beyond MPI were added.\n\n**Design.** The distance and path matrices are distributed over a Pr × Pc process grid in block-cyclic fashion with 32-node blocks. The k loop runs in the same blocks. For each block, the diagonal rank evolves its 32×32 tile and records per-pivot snapshots, the ranks in the owning process row and column evolve the pivot row and column strips, and those strips are broadcast along process columns and rows. Every rank then applies the 32 pivots in original order to the rest of its tile through a vectorized, tiled kernel. The pivot work and broadcasts for block c+1 are issued while block c is being applied, with periodic polling so the nonblocking broadcasts progress. Every matrix element receives exactly the same sequence of min-updates as the serial code, so distances and path entries are bit-identical.\n\n**Correctness.** The `-r` hash, min, max and samples match the untouched serial build for every combination of n in {1, 2, 7, 64, 200, 512, 1000} and rank counts {1, 2, 3, 8, 13, 16, 64}, including prime rank counts that degrade to a 1×P grid. Validation passes in all cases, and rank 0's exit code is broadcast so all ranks exit alike.\n\n**Performance** on this 2-socket EPYC box (times in ms):\n\n| n | serial original | 1 rank | 4 | 16 | 64 | 128 |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 512 | 165 | 28 | 8 | 3 | 3 | 3 |\n| 2048 | ~10500 (est.) | 1879 | 464 | 108 | 35 | 23 |\n| 4096 | | | 3747 | 861 | 246 | 119 |\n\nAn earlier 1D row-distributed version stalled past 32 ranks because each rank had to receive the full pivot block every step and this machine's collectives are slow for that volume. The 2D grid cuts per-rank traffic by roughly √P and keeps collectives inside process rows and columns.\n\n**Build.** `CMakeLists.txt` now uses `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)` and links `MPI::MPI_CXX`. A fresh configure and build with `-Wall -Wextra` is warning-free.\n\nNote that the matrix is still initialized in full on rank 0 and distributed from there, matching the original's single-seed random sequence, so rank 0 holds an n² buffer in addition to its tile."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":450,"cache_read_input_tokens":153570,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":450},"output_tokens":769,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6239300a-b382-49a9-93b2-8daff2d51e76","uuid":"beb316d8-90ee-49a3-b380-d1a9ffe4464f","timestamp":"2026-10-17T04:57:13.823Z","request_id":"req_011Cg7DUQbLgHKKkbj2u2s2w"}

Only the two existing files were modified, the executable is still named `floydwarshall`, and no new dependencies beyond MPI were added.\n\n**Design.** The distance and path matrices are distributed over a Pr × Pc process grid in block-cyclic fashion with 32-node blocks. The k loop runs in the same blocks. For each block, the diagonal rank evolves its 32×32 tile and records per-pivot snapshots, the ranks in the owning process row and column evolve the pivot row and column strips, and those strips are broadcast along process columns and rows. Every rank then applies the 32 pivots in original order to the rest of its tile through a vectorized, tiled kernel. The pivot work and broadcasts for block c+1 are issued while block c is being applied, with periodic polling so the nonblocking broadcasts progress. Every matrix element receives exactly the same sequence of min-updates as the serial code, so distances and path entries are bit-identical.\n\n**Correctness.** The `-r` hash, min, max and samples match the untouched serial build for every combination of n in {1, 2, 7, 64, 200, 512, 1000} and rank counts {1, 2, 3, 8, 13, 16, 64}, including prime rank counts that degrade to a 1×P grid. Validation passes in all cases, and rank 0's exit code is broadcast so all ranks exit alike.\n\n**Performance** on this 2-socket EPYC box (times in ms):\n\n| n | serial original | 1 rank | 4 | 16 | 64 | 128 |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 512 | 165 | 28 | 8 | 3 | 3 | 3 |\n| 2048 | ~10500 (est.) | 1879 | 464 | 108 | 35 | 23 |\n| 4096 | | | 3747 | 861 | 246 | 119 |\n\nAn earlier 1D row-distributed version stalled past 32 ranks because each rank had to receive the full pivot block every step and this machine's collectives are slow for that volume.
